purpose: post-v4 nonhuman holdout for exact canonical NER/RE; not independent human gold

selection.population: processed papers excluding all 48 papers in dev12, cross-check12, holdout v3, and holdout v4
selection.eligibility: abstract length >= 300 and neutral extraction cue regex present: dataset|benchmark|corpus|evaluate|experiment|method|model|framework|task|propose|introduce (with inflections)
selection.prediction_blind_detail: selected and labelled from processed abstracts only; existing per-paper extractor caches for these IDs were not read before the labels SHA-256 was frozen

decision_rule.go_threshold: both F1 values must be >= 0.50 on the first v5 score

issues: some manually assigned IDs do not match the frozen ontology, including dataset:ptb versus dataset:penn-treebank and dataset:sst-2 versus dataset:sst
some acronym expansions use a different canonical-ID policy than the retained canonicalizer
post_score_label_audit.interpretation: retain the failed exact score for provenance, but do not treat v5 as a clean estimate; future gold must freeze surfaces and derive IDs under the frozen ontology

limitations: Single nonhuman annotator; no inter-annotator agreement.
Selection is cue-enriched rather than a prevalence estimate for all 1,091 papers.
The slice is small and its labels reflect one explicit entity inclusion protocol.
Useful as a leakage-separated diagnostic only; it cannot satisfy an independent-human gate.
